startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: Home page of the website to audit. Only audit sites you own or are allowed to test.

maxPages.title: Max pages to crawl
maxPages.description: Same-origin pages only. The crawler respects robots.txt and fetches 1 page per second.

lighthousePages.title: Pages to run Lighthouse on
lighthousePages.description: Lighthouse runs on the first N pages found (starting with the start URL). 0 disables it.

formFactor.title: Lighthouse device
formFactor.description: Device emulation for Lighthouse: mobile (throttled, like Google PageSpeed) or desktop.

checkExternalLinks.title: Check external links
checkExternalLinks.description: HEAD-request outbound links to find broken ones (max 1 request/second per host).

renderJs.title: Render JavaScript
renderJs.description: Analyze pages after JavaScript runs (for React, Vue, Next.js and other single-page apps). Slower; turn on if checks report missing titles/H1 that you can see in the browser.
